community.invite_body: Send a friend an email invite. After they register on Rovas, you can find each other via Community search.
community.invite_message_placeholder: Add a short note for your friend…
community.invite_default_body:
I'm using Civic to track my contribution to society (taxes, charity, volunteering) via Merits on Rovas.

Create a Rovas account here:
https://dev.rovas.app/user/register

Then open Civic and look me up under Community.
